description: This file contains unit tests for the BaseAttributeTypeValidator class in the OpenMRS project, specifically testing validation logic for VisitAttributeType objects.

classes.name: BaseAttributeTypeValidatorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for validating the behavior of BaseAttributeTypeValidator implementations within the OpenMRS framework.

classes.name: CustomVisitAttributeTypeValidator
classes.description: Inner class extending BaseAttributeTypeValidator to test validation logic for VisitAttributeType.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Setup method annotated with @BeforeEach to initialize test objects before each test case.

methods.name: shouldFailIfGivenNull
methods.description: Test to verify validation fails when the input object is null.

methods.name: shouldFailIfNameIsNull
methods.description: Test to verify validation fails when the name property of the attribute type is null.

methods.name: shouldFailIfNameIsEmpty
methods.description: Test to verify validation fails when the name property is an empty string.

methods.name: shouldFailIfNameIsOnlyWhitespaces
methods.description: Test to verify validation fails when the name property consists solely of whitespace.

methods.name: shouldFailIfMinOccursIsLessThanZero

methods.description: Test to ensure maxOccurs is at least 1.

methods.name: validate_shouldRequireDatatypeClassname
methods.description: Test to validate that datatypeClassname is required.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfFieldLengthsAreCorrect
